conclusion: No candidate accepted. Power-facing violations dominate the 164x159 legalizer trace, but that outline is not an area reduction. The genuinely smaller outlines fail earlier in interior seating: USB-JTAG at 164x158 and bringup_modules at 165x157. Failure-directed ordering changes the failed subject to USB-PD or USB-JTAG, without solving the board. Target joint seating/shape choices before spending more on facing or joint-separation budgets.

Keep hardware constraints, explicit shape selections, failed-attempt receipts and incumbent preservation.
